nodes.text: The world is in danger again. HMPV virus outbreak in China and spreading rapidly. Similar to COVID-19, it also targets the respiratory system, causing flu-like symptoms, cough, fever, bronchitis, and pneunomia. Effects particularly among children under the age of 14.

nodes.author: noxinocupoh
nodes.text: There is no vaccine available to treat HMPV infection. Stay safe everyone, wear a mask and use hand sanitizer.
